equipment.serving: Mezzanine to downtown platform
equipment.alternativeroute:
If you are on the mezzanine: For A/C, take an uptown A or C to 168 St and use elevators to transfer to a downtown A or C. For B/D, take an uptown B or D to 161 St-Yankee Stadium and use elevators to transfer to a downtown B or D.
If you are on the platform: Take a downtown A, C, B or D to 59 St-Columbus Circle and use elevators to transfer to an uptown A, C, B or D to 125 St. Or, take a downtown A, C, B or D to 59 St-Columbus Circle. Use elevators to exit the station and take a Harlem-bound M10 bus (Central Park West and Columbus Circle) to Fredrick Douglass Blvd and 125 St. Proceed one block west to St. Nicholas Av.

equipment.serving: 125 St & St Nicholas Ave (SW corner) to mezzanine for service in both directions
equipment.alternativeroute:
If you are on the street: Take a Fort George-bound M3 bus (St Nicholas Av and 124 St) to 167 St for 168 St A/C Station.
For B/D, take a downtown A or C from 168 St to 125 St and transfer. If you're on the platform: Take an uptown A or C to 168 St. Use elevators to exit the station and take an East Village-bound M3 bus (Broadway and 168 St) to St. Nicholas Av and 125 St.

equipment.serving: mezzanine to uptown A/C/E platform
equipment.shortdescription: Upper Mezzanine to Northbound A/C/E trains Platform level (Front)
equipment.busconnections: M14A, M14D, M20 (northbound at 8th Av and southbound at 7 Av), M11 (northbound at 9th Av), M12 (northbound at 8 Av)
equipment.alternativeroute:
This elevator is out of service for replacement. Read on for alternatives:
If you are on the mezzanine: Take a downtown A, C or E to W 4 St and use ramps to transfer to an uptown A, C or E. 
If you are on the uptown A/C/E platform: Take an uptown A to 34 St-Penn Station and transfer across the platform to a downtown A to 14 St.

equipment.serving: mezzanine to downtown A/C/E platform
equipment.busconnections: M14A, M14D, M20 (northbound at 8th Av and southbound at 7 Av), M11 (northbound at 9th Av), M12 (northbound at 8 Av)
equipment.alternativeroute:
Elevators at this station are out of service for replacement. Read on for alternatives:

If you are on the mezzanine:
Exit through the faregates and use the elevator to exit the station. Then take a Lincoln Center-bound M20 bus to 34 St-Penn Station for downtown A, C or E service. 

If you are on the downtown A/C/E platform:
Take a downtown A, C or E to W 4 St and transfer to a 44 St-bound M55 bus (6 Av/Waverly Pl) to 16 St, then transfer to an Abingdon Sq-bound M14A bus or Chelsea Piers-bound M14D bus (14 St and Irving Pl) to 8 Av.

equipment.serving: 8th Ave & 14 St (NW corner) to mezzanine for A/C/E/L service in both directions
equipment.busconnections: M14A, M14D, M20 (northbound at 8th Av and southbound at 7 Av), M11 (northbound at 9th Av), M12 (northbound at 8 Av)
equipment.alternativeroute:
If you are at street level: Take a Lower East Side-bound M14A bus or M14D bus to 6 Av for L and F/M service. For A/C/E, take a downtown F/M to W 4 St and transfer to A/C/E.

If you are in the mezzanine: Take a Brooklyn-bound L to 6 Av. Exit the station and take an Abingdon Sq-bound M14A bus or Chelsea Piers-bound M14D bus (NW corner of 14 St and 6 Av) to 8 Av.

equipment.serving: mezzanine to uptown N/Q/R/W platform
equipment.busconnections: M1, M2, M3, M14A SBS, M14D SBS
equipment.alternativeroute:
If you are on the platform: 
Take an uptown N,Q, R, or W to 34 St-Herald Sq and use elevators to transfer to a downtown F or M to 14 St. Use elevators to transfer to a downtown F or M to 14 St. Use elevators to exit the station and take an LES-bound M14A or M14D to 4 Av.  

If you are on the mezzanine: 
Take a downtown R or W (N overnight) to City Hall, see agent to cross the platform and transfer to an uptown R or W (N overnight).Transfer to N or Q at 14 St-Union Sq.

equipment.serving: B/D mezzanine to Woodlawn-bound 4 platform and mezzanine for Manhattan-bound 4 service
equipment.alternativeroute:
To access street level: Take a Woodlawn-bound 4 to 170 St. Exit station and proceed east to Grand Concourse. Then, take a Mott Haven-bound Bx1 or Bx2 bus to Grand Concourse and E 161 St.

To access B/D service: Take a Woodlawn-bound 4 to 170 St. Exit station and proceed east to Grand Concourse. Then, take a Riverdale-bound Bx1 or Kingsbridge Heights-bound Bx2 to Tremont Av for access to BD service.

To access 4 service: Go 3 blocks east along 161 St to Grand Concourse. Take a Mott Haven-bound Bx1 or Bx2 from Grand Concourse/E 161 St (in front of Bronx Borough Hall) to Grand Concourse/E 149 St. Then, take the 4 train at 149 St-Hostos station.

equipment.serving: 161 St & River Ave (NE corner) to mezzanine to reach 4/B/D service in both directions
equipment.busconnections: Bx6, Bx6 SBS, Bx13/Bx1, Bx1 LTD, Bx2, BxM4, Bx6, Bx6 SBS, Bx13, Bx32.
equipment.alternativeroute:
For Manhattan-bound service: Reduced-Fare MetroCard/OMNY holders may ride Metro-north between the nearby Yankees-E 153 St station and Grand Central at no additional charge. You must present your Reduced-Fare MetroCard or Reduced-Fare OMNY card to the conductor to use this service. To access the Yankees-E 153 St station, travel south on River Av to 157 St and proceed west to the station. Take a Grand Central-bound train and transfer at 125 St or Grand Central for onward subway service.

For B/D: Proceed east along 161 St to Grand Concourse. Take a Riverdale-bound Bx1 or Kingsbridge Heights-bound Bx2 bus to Tremont Av for B/D service in both directions.

For Woodlawn-bound 4 stations: Proceed east along 161 St to Grand Concourse and take a Riverdale-bound Bx1 or a Kingsbridge Heights-bound Bx2. Exit at 170 St for the 170 St 4 station, at Fordham Rd for the Fordham Rd 4 station, or at Jerome Av for the Mosholu Pkwy 4 station. Accessible Manhattan-bound 4 service is also available at 170 St and Mosholu Pkwy.

equipment.serving: uptown C/E platform to lower mezzanine for access to Penn Station concourse and rest of complex
equipment.alternativeroute:
This elevator is out of service for replacement. 

For uptown and Queens-bound service from the mezzanine, take an uptown A to 42 St - Port Authority Bus Terminal and transfer to C or E. Alternatively, proceed to the NE corner of 8 Av and 34 St. Then, take a Lincoln Center-bound M20 or PA Bus Terminal-bound M34A to 8 Av and 40 St. Enter the 42 St - Port Authority Bus Terminal station for access to A/C/E service.

To exit, take an uptown C or E to 42 St - Port Authority Bus Terminal. Use ramps to change directions and take a downtown A, C, or E to 34 St - Penn Station.

equipment.alternativeroute: If you are on the street: Proceed to 7 Av and take a downtown M7, M20, or M104 bus to Times Sq-42 St. If you are at the platform: Contact a station agent to re-enter through the faregate then either: Take a Queens-bound R to Queens Plaza and use elevators to transfer to a Manhattan-bound E to 50 St. Use elevators to exit the station. equipment.alternativeroute:

If you are on the platform: 
Take a Coney Island-bound F or Church Av-bound G train to Church Av and use elevators to transfer to the Manhattan and Queens-bound platform for service to 7 Av.
